states.noVehicle: Budget and model-card panels receive no query and explain vehicle selection. Round review is disabled. The evidence summary still renders its query-unaware absence assertions: FL001.
states.initialFetching: Budget brief derives loading; model-card InsightPanel derives loading. The form/privacy copy remain present. The evidence summary does not receive this state: FL001.
states.initialPausedOrUnresolved: Query-aware panels have explicit paused/unresolved text. No cards are inferred from a successful empty response before one exists. The lower evidence summary is inconsistent: FL001.
states.initialFatal: Budget and model-card source owners expose their fatal-error/retry paths without suppressing the form or privacy statement. The summary still claims returned-result absence: FL001.
states.resolvedEmpty: Model-card panel shows the supported no-cards message with refresh. Returned quality/evidence/privacy totals can remain meaningful despite an empty current card page.
states.populated: Current-scope budget, cards and their four metadata rows render. Nullable latest sample/aggregate/status values have explicit placeholders.
states.backgroundRefresh: Model cards retain data with DataFreshness; AnalysisBrief has a refreshing label.
states.retainedFailureOrPaused: InsightPanel keeps cards and shows nonblocking warning/recovery. AnalysisBrief retains metrics and retry. The lower summary has no local source freshness context; its lack of bound state is included in FL001.
states.review: Review copies the draft and selected vehicle. Confirmation open/disabled/callback all check that same vehicle. The callback submits the stored review rather than a newly read draft.
states.mutationPending: Review submit is disabled; dialog loading disables confirm/cancel/backdrop/Escape through ConfirmDialog. Paused-mutation presentation was not established: FL-C04.
states.mutationFailure: Error is scoped to the request vehicle and shown both outside and inside the still-open dialog.
states.mutationSuccess: Only the same review closes. Scoped mutation quality/evidence may replace list quality/evidence, but returned model-card limitations are not forwarded: FL004.
states.vehicleChange: Guarded render-time scope comparison resets page to one, draft to defaults and review to null before the new offset is calculated. Mutation error/result are filtered by vehicle. No former cross-vehicle-confirmation defect is carried forward.
states.pagination: PAGE_SIZE=12; pager appears only when total>12. Current-scope shrinking-total behavior remains an unpromoted candidate, FL-C01.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-026: unresolved/failed source data is not an authoritative empty or unsupported result
confirmedIssues.detail: The lower summary receives data only, not selected-scope/query state. Before any response, after an initial failure, or with no vehicle, it says quality metadata is unsupported, no supporting evidence was returned and no additional limitations were returned. Its internal query-free InsightPanel resolves to ready. Upper panels correctly distinguish these states; this is a lower-panel inconsistency, not a claim that the whole page lacks recovery.
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Missing query.data and roundResult produce undefined quality/evidence and cards=[]; EvidencePanel normalizes arrays and renders result-like absence messages without source state. Retained summary data likewise has no bound freshness/recovery context.
sourceDerivedRepro: Reason about a selected-vehicle list query with no retained payload and fetching, paused, unresolved or initial fatal state; do not mount it.
Trace page268-271: EvidencePanel still mounts with undefined quality/evidence and empty limitations.
Trace EvidencePanel's query-free InsightPanel and missing-data branches: all three absence assertions render independently of upper-panel source state.
confirmedIssues.fix: A separately assigned integration may thread the existing source/query contract into the dynamic evidence sections, preserve the panel shell and static unsupported explanations, and distinguish unresolved/paused/fatal/authoritative-empty/retained states without duplicating upper notices.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-044: dates obey saved locale and display-timezone preferences
confirmedIssues.detail: Budget observation-window/generated labels and evidence observation times use bare formatDateTime(value). That helper defaults to browser locale/timezone; these callsites never pass saved preferences or use the existing settings-bound hook.
confirmedIssues.mechanism: No FormatOptions argument reaches intlLocale/intlOpts, so the browser defaults are used even when the user's configured timezone/locale differ. The useDateFormat owner already resolves the intended locale and effective timezone.
sourceDerivedRepro: Reason about a browser-default zone distinct from a saved UTC/vehicle display zone, and a saved locale distinct from browser locale.
Trace a valid UTC timestamp through AnalysisBrief71-72/118 and EvidencePanel62/90/92.
Follow dateFormat's undefined opts path; saved preference changes cannot alter the chosen date options at these callsites.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-044: locale-aware numeric interpolation and plural forms
confirmedIssues.detail: Evidence sample captions pass raw sample_count into plain {{count}} interpolation, and the confirmation passes raw epsilon into plain {{epsilon}} interpolation. These bypass fmtInt/fmtNumber despite nearby metadata using them. Canonical English sampleLine/evidenceSamples contain only the plural wording, with no one/other peers found, so count=1 selects '1 samples'.
confirmedIssues.mechanism: i18n initialization provides escapeValue=false but no locale-aware numeric interpolation formatter. The unformatted placeholders stringify numeric inputs; changing the saved numeric locale does not localize their digits/separators. The base English key cannot choose a singular form.
sourceDerivedRepro: Reason about saved numeric locale de-DE and evidence sample_count=12345: the caption receives raw 12345 while adjacent fmtInt output uses localized grouping.
Reason about a reviewed epsilon of 0.1: the confirmation receives raw 0.1 instead of locale-aware 0,1.
Reason about sample_count=1: the canonical English base captions still contain 'samples'.
confirmedIssues.reproExecution: NOTRUN; no fixture, i18n runtime or confirmation was executed
confirmedIssues.fix: Keep numeric count for plural selection and separately format its displayed value with the existing numeric hook. Coordinate exact singular/plural catalog leaves through their serialized owner. Format confirmation epsilon without rounding away a valid privacy spend; preserve the submitted numeric payload.
confirmedIssues.owner: domain/page callsites plus serialized catalog integration

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-026/MDC-046: limitations must follow the displayed result's provenance
confirmedIssues.detail: When the scoped round result supplies the summary's quality/evidence, its returned model_card.limitations are never passed. Limitations are always flattened from the currently paginated list cards. A successful round can therefore display its evidence with no limitations, or unrelated cards' limitations, rather than its own returned limitations.
confirmedIssues.mechanism: quality/evidence prefer roundResult, but limitations unconditionally use cards.flatMap. FederatedRoundResult.model_card includes a limitations array. With list data still unresolved, or the returned card absent from the current page, its limitations cannot reach the summary.
sourceDerivedRepro: Reason about a legal scoped round-result value whose model_card.limitations is nonempty while the current list has no payload or does not contain that card.
Trace the result selection at page58 and the three EvidencePanel props at269-271.
Round evidence/quality render, but limitations=[] can select 'No additional limitations were returned' even though the chosen round result contains limitations.
confirmedIssues.reproExecution: NOTRUN; no round, request, fixture or training action was run
confirmedIssues.fix: Bind limitations to the same winning result as quality/evidence, including returned model-card limitations when round evidence is displayed. Preserve list/page limitations as a clearly scoped separate source if still needed; do not silently merge unrelated provenance.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-040/MDC-043: declare at least 44px mobile interactive allocation
confirmedIssues.detail: The five page Input callsites inherit md's min-h-10 (40px) with no below-md 44px override. AnalysisBrief's retained Retry uses an unwrapped size=sm Button with h-9 (36px). This source-level allocation is below the contract's mobile default, unlike the page's prefill/review actions and dialog footer, which explicitly use min-h-11.
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Input defaults size to md and applies its 40px minimum at every breakpoint; these callsites supply no className/size override. The brief Retry applies fixed h-9 without a caller mobile minimum or wrapLabel.
sourceDerivedRepro: Trace the five default Input calls at a below-md viewport through Input's size='md' and min-h-10 classes.
Trace a retained budget-source state that exposes the Retry button through Button's size='sm' h-9 classes.
Compare declared 40px/36px allocation with MDC-040's 44px default; do not treat this as measured native geometry.

confirmedIssues.fix: A separately assigned caller fix can declare a 44px mobile minimum and restore desktop sizing; give Retry existing wrapping behavior for long labels. Preserve native validation, density choices, labels, refs and actions rather than globally resizing unrelated controls.
